findings.section: 一个慢客户端的容量算例
findings.original_issue: Remote client consumption rate was used directly as the outflow of an intermediate engine/transport queue; downstream buffers can absorb data before backpressure reaches that queue.
findings.requested_change: State the measured/assumed arrival and departure rates of the same bounded queue; distinguish remote consumption and downstream buffered bytes.
findings.resolution: Root changed the example to actual local enqueue 8000 B/s and dequeue 2000 B/s, and added buffering/backpressure scope. Reviewer reread the changed section.
evidence: ASGI Response Body only guarantees delivery to server send buffer, not remote consumption.
Queue conservation applies to rates at the same queue boundary.

findings.section: 将接收、完成、提交和释放分别表达
findings.original_issue: The blanket claim about an ASGI send return flushing data to the server send buffer is too broad. Response Start is explicitly allowed to defer this flush; the guarantee is in Response Body.
findings.requested_change: Bind the claim to successful http.response.body handling and distinguish http.response.start; preserve the statement that remote consumption is not confirmed.

evidence.meaning: Response Start need not flush until first Response Body.
Response Body must flush body data to send buffer before send returns.

findings.resolution: Root narrowed the flush guarantee to successful http.response.body send handling and explicitly distinguished http.response.start. Reviewer reread the full revised chapter and fixed-source lines 179-245; the text now matches the source and does not imply remote consumption.

positive_findings: From-scratch construction explicitly declares reuse boundaries, permits alternative physical architectures and conditions optimization mechanisms on task requirements.
Current paged KV footprint is explicitly separated from worst-case admission promise; paging is not claimed to make the worst-case fit.
CPU quota and CPU service demand are expressed in time units, with ancestor and contention qualifications; numerical examples are dimensionally consistent.
Cancellation receipt, result commit, device completion and memory reuse are separated; generations do not claim to prevent late DMA into early-reused storage.
Subprocess pipe deadlock and timeout distinctions match fixed source; shutdown includes control-path reachability and eventual device/host drain.
Source mechanisms, original design synthesis and hypothetical arithmetic are explicitly separated; no GPU or agent-run success is manufactured.
limits: This is a source/logic/document review, not execution of an ASGI service, engine, scheduler, GPU kernel or task campaign.
Only enumerated primary-source regions were read; unchanged prior Borg/OpenTelemetry/device-plugin attributions were not independently re-audited.
Approval applies only to listed file hashes and semantic scope; it does not establish empirical performance, practical completeness of an agent implementation or research novelty.
Parent owns integrating final source metadata, history and catalog; chapter link checks do not verify those ledgers.
